question: Compare scratch,GDI,HealthGait with training-only BN calibration before every inner validation and final prediction; include same-input Ridge/RF.

pretraining.labels: OptoGait/MuscleLAB measured speed, cadence, step and stride by UGS/FGS; never pose-estimated labels or age/PA substitutes
pretraining.caveat: Measurements precede rather than synchronize with the videos; repeated condition-level person labels
pretraining.selection: Fixed label-independent participant 80/20 split; select epoch only in source validation people, refit all eligible source people for selected epochs
pretraining.loss: smooth_l1 on training-person z-scored measured labels, to reduce influence of observed source outliers; labels are never corrected or clipped

target.dataset: OlderAdults44 xgw6bg3g8h v1, actual supplied SPPB total, 44 people / 220 trials
target.limitations: Vicon 3D optical markers projected to sagittal plane, not markerless RGB; LASI/RASI surface-marker hip proxies differ from image hip centers; actual labels cover 5..12 only
target.epochs: Median of inner-fold best epochs, then refit outer training people; no outer labels select epochs, candidates or calibration
target.aggregation: Equal mean of left/right predictions, windows within trial, then trials within person; training weights give each person equal total loss mass

input.health_window_origin: Start at first frame with all six required joints observed, then stride30 frames within last observed frame; do not treat empty entry/exit frames as motion
input.resampling: Linear interpolation to 124 positions in observed 3 seconds, never extrapolation; no assertion of added information
input.normalization: Hip midpoint subtraction and per-frame mean thigh-length division; 1-frame Gaussian smoothing; no population standardization of inputs; screen raw missing coordinates <=25%, gaps interpolate only inside selected window
input.orientation: No horizontal reflection (same policy as existing GDI model); OlderAdults44 projects +travel to image x and -vertical to image y
input.gdi_transfer: Fixed existing multiwindow fold0 checkpoint chosen before target fitting. Slice first convolution to first six semantically matched coordinate channels, preserve remaining convolution/BN/hidden weights, reset output. No GDI output calibration or GDI labels transfer.
input.time_caveat: Existing GDI public JSON native timebase remains unverified; transfer is exploratory, not a time-aligned reproduction

model: Existing GdiCNN six convolution blocks, 32 channels, kernel8, pooling2/2/3, hidden10; first conv6 channels, output replaced for each target; mean side hidden representations before output
optimization: AdamW, batch32 windows, loss per-person weighted training-person-only z-scored MSE; no output clipping/rounding/calibration; fixed identical target candidates across all arms
baseline: Same-input Ridge/RF and training-person mean/median, all selected within the same nested participant folds.
comparison: Same people/trials/folds/seeds/hyperparameter-selection rules for three arms; report each seed and seed ensemble, not only best seed
verification: Actual CUDA optimizer pilot; finite losses and parameters; checkpoint reload prediction equality; provenance SHA256; person-disjoint splits; expected fits; independent metrics and saved-model CPU replay; preserve protected final GDI sets
scope: 44person exploratory development comparison. New source pretraining uses395people; functional labels remain44. Prior post-hoc diagnostics are not the new result.

bn_policy.transfer: Only learned backbone weights/affine parameters are retained; old running statistics reset before target fitting.
bn_policy.optimization: Regular training-mode mini-batch BN and dropout; no validation/test data in optimization.
bn_policy.inference_statistics: After every epoch before validation, disable dropout and recompute all BN buffers in one full training-only no-gradient pass with momentum1. Each layer observes current training-batch activations. Save the calibrated checkpoint.
bn_policy.refit: After the fixed selected epochs, perform the identical training-only calibration before checkpointing and inference.
bn_policy.source_pretrain: Retrain HealthGait source selection/refit under the identical policy. GDI source weights remain the fixed prior fold0 weights.
bn_policy.scope: Source-pretraining selection and target selection are both BN-corrected, so compare corrected complete pipelines rather than attributing every change solely to target calibration.
bn_policy.verify: Independent CPU recomputation of every saved BN buffer, training IDs/window-index hash, epoch choice and prediction replay; test batch-size invariance and no parameter updates during calibration.

baselines.input: Identical target.npz; each trial side2*6coordinates summarized by temporal mean/std/mean_absolute_difference:36features. No speed,3D,age or extra input.
baselines.selection: Same outer5 and inner3 participant folds; training-only StandardScaler and equal person weights; report all seeds and RF seed ensemble.
baselines.saved_models: D received/baselines/models, joblib reload and metric replay
